name: Brythons
summary: The Celtic people who inhabited Great Britain from at least the British Iron Age until the High Middle Ages, at which point they diverged into the Welsh, Cornish, and Bretons.

not_applicable.capital: A people of many British kingdoms, not one state with a capital

not_applicable.before: The Britons are the native Iron Age population of Britain; no earlier state preceded them
